mapper.sql: SELECT c.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_code AS categoryCode, c.category_name AS categoryName, c.icon_url AS iconUrl, c.sort_order AS sortOrder, IFNULL(project_stat.project_count, 0) AS projectCount FROM category c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS project_count FROM performance_project GROUP BY category_id ) project_stat ON project_stat.category_id = c.category_id
mapper.select: ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.category_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM category WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
